title: Effect inbox and reply identity

commands.report: 262 unit tests pass; effects.test.mjs covers W10/W11/W20/W04

tests: W10 the idempotency key isolates actor, method and requestId
W10 same hash replays the stored result, a different payload is a CONFLICT
W10 one actor never reads another actor result for the same requestId
W11 an effect records segment, attempt and provider id per leaf
W11 restart marks started effects uncertain and planned effects cancelled, never replayed
W11 aggregate layering keeps accepted below confirmed and flags uncertainty
W20 a duplicate inbound event is not processed twice
W20 the cursor never advances past an in-flight event
a reply context is pinned to the principal and hides transport secrets from views
W04 a reply ref stores only the token hash and scopes lookup to account/chat
